newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM precious metals end mostly lower,platinum up.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM precious metals end mostly lower,platinum up.

text.p: Most yen-based Tokyo precious metals ended lower on Thursday with July, August and October palladium glued to their daily limit-lows throughout the day on the expected resumption of Russian sales, traders said.
Only platinum futures ended higher in a technical correction of recent declines, they said.
Palladium futures ranged from six yen to 24 yen per gram lower. Benchmark April closed eight yen weaker at 535 yen.
"After covering their shorts, private investors tended to build fresh shorts in palladium, based on views prices will fall when Russia resumes sales," a trading house trader said.
